objective: Assess the presence and boundaries of the living architecture-figure profile added for audit-method-data-flow v0.2.2.
scope: unobserved display clarity and released activation

claims.statement: The source defines how to build a living architecture figure: project-kept source republished to one address, four separate surfaces, per-lane input/operation/output, learned-state and exchange boxes, non-color gate cues, a visible hold-out boundary and defined table numbers.
claims.rationale: Direct inspection of the reference section, its entrypoint route and its contract test establishes the presence of these instructions only.

claims.statement: The source requires reconciling every label with actual run settings after each change, marking overrides, rerunning the final checklist and reporting visual status honestly.
claims.rationale: Direct inspection of the reference section establishes the presence of these instructions only.

claims.statement: Figures built with the profile are measurably clearer to first readers, and the profile is active in freshly installed released copies.
claims.rationale: No reader study or released-consumer activation was observed in this scoped inspection.

evidence_items.observed_summary: The reference contains the Living architecture-figure profile with build and update steps; these are source instructions, not observed effectiveness.
The entrypoint names the living architecture-figure profile among the gates the figure reference defines.
A contract test checks that the profile is routed and contains its required build and update phrases.
Publication and fresh consumer activation are separate lifecycle gates; this source inspection does not execute them.

unresolved_uncertainties: Display clarity for first readers, publication of v0.2.2 and fresh released-consumer activation have not yet been observed. Source and package tests do not establish those outcomes.
